_provenance.status: APP-AUTHORED role records — identity-access publishes no role table in this build
note: rbac-scopes-v1 rule 4: roles are data, not code. No role/permission endpoint or contract is frozen, so this file records the four roles the identity-access seed actually grants (lib/fixtures/auth/personas.json, which mirrors identity-access/db/seeds.rb).

Each role's scope list is EXACTLY the seeded persona's scope list — admin@vm.demo, staff@vm.demo, agent@vm.demo, customer@vm.demo — in the same order; the role labels read the seed accounts' own names. tests/fixture-contract/access-control.test.ts fails on any drift, and on a scope outside docs/08-delivery/contracts/rbac-scopes-v1.md.

The roles screen (/staff/users) reads this file through lib/api-client/access-control.ts. The provisioning API that would create users and assign roles does not exist; the file is display data with provenance, never a write path.
